svg.desc: ТПТС (SR или KR) задатчик регулятора для Dull Screen

rt:param.name: BG_StaticColor
rt:param.comment: Имя цвета подложки, если объект не должен быть прозрачным

rt:var.name: MyStrokeWdth
rt:var.comment: Толщина рамок в зависимости от управляемости

rt:model.rt:sub: Sub ShowVal() If !NoReadings Then If AA03 != Nothing Then Value_text.text = AA03.ValueAscii() Dim ValColor As UInt ValColor = PRJSPEC.ANA_Color_pv (AA03) backgr.fill = ValColor If ShowGoodColor Then If ValColor == Color_ANA_GOOD Then backgr.fill_opacity = 0.5 Else backgr.fill_opacity = 1 End If Else If ValColor == Color_ANA_GOOD Then backgr.visibility = "hidden" Else backgr.visibility = "visible" End If End If Else l.visibility = "hidden" r.visibility = "hidden" backgr.fill = Color_ANA_ER_LINK Value_text.text = "Ошибка" End If End If End Sub
rt:model.rt:event: AltWidth.visibility = "hidden" If (KKS != "NULL") Then //Z0 и OU не нужны для рамки неисправности, но OU надо для определения прав доступа OU = BIN(KKS + "_OU") VB11 = BIN(KKS + "_VB11") If (!requests_allown) Then AA03 = ANA(KKS + "_XQ07") Else Set AA03 = ANA(KKS + "_AA3") If AA03 == nothing Then Set AA03 = ANA(KKS + "_XQ07") End If End If End If Dim My_w As Float Dim My_h As Float My_w = _This.width My_h = _This.height Static_BG.x = 5 Static_BG.y = 5 Static_BG.height = My_h - 10 backgr.x = 5 backgr.y = 5 backgr.height = My_h - 10 Al_frame.x = 2.5 Al_frame.y = 2.5 Al_frame.height = My_h - 5 SelFrame.x = 2.5 SelFrame.y = 2.5 SelFrame.height = My_h - 5 If NoReadings Then If AA03 == Nothing Then backgr.fill = Color_ANA_ER_LINK Value_text.text = "Ош." l.visibility = "hidden" r.visibility = "hidden" Else backgr.visibility = "hidden" Value_text.text = "0" Value_text.fill = "Col_Grey5" l.points = "7.5,"+CStr(My_h / 3)+" 15,"+CStr(My_h / 2)+" 7.5,"+CStr(My_h / 1.5 ) r.points = CStr(My_w / 2 - 7.5)+","+CStr(My_h / 3)+" "+CStr(My_w / 2 - 15)+","+CStr(My_h / 2)+" "+CStr(My_w / 2 - 7.5)+","+CStr(My_h / 1.5) End If Static_BG.width = My_w / 2 - 10 backgr.width = My_w / 2 - 10 Value_text.x = My_w / 4 RB_edge.points = "5,"+CStr(My_h - 5)+" "+CStr(My_w / 2 - 5)+","+CStr(My_h - 5)+" "+CStr(My_w / 2 - 5)+",5" LU_edge.points = "5,"+CStr(My_h - 5)+" 5,5 "+CStr(My_w / 2 - 5)+",5" Al_frame.width = My_w / 2 - 5 InGr.width = My_w / 2 SelFrame.width = My_w / 2 - 5 Else Static_BG.width = My_w - 10 backgr.width = My_w - 10 l.points = "7.5," + CStr(My_h / 3) + " 15," + CStr(My_h / 2) + " 7.5," + CStr(My_h / 1.5) r.points = CStr(My_w - 7.5) + "," + CStr(My_h / 3) + " " + CStr(My_w - 15) + "," + CStr(My_h / 2) + " " + CStr(My_w - 7.5) + "," + CStr(My_h / 1.5) RB_edge.points = "5,"+CStr(My_h - 5)+" "+CStr(My_w - 5)+","+CStr(My_h - 5)+" "+CStr(My_w - 5)+",5" LU_edge.points = "5,"+CStr(My_h - 5)+" 5,5 "+CStr(My_w - 5)+",5" Al_frame.width = My_w - 5 SelFrame.width = My_w - 5 End If

rect.rt:event: If AA03 != nothing Then Open_ws_wf_wi("TPTS_Reg_set", KKS, Operate) Else NoLink(KKS) End If
If AA03 != nothing Then If Operate && Check_Oper_Rights(OU) Then LoadPopUpMenu(KKS + "|SR o|TPTS_Reg_set " + KKS) Else LoadPopUpMenu(KKS + "|SR i|TPTS_Reg_set " + KKS) End If Else NoLink(KKS) End If
If AA03 != nothing Then Open_Win_Uni(False, "rights", "Права управления", "wi_rights", KKS+"|"+CStr(Operate)) Else NoLink(KKS) End If
